name: u1-base-shaper-calibrate
title: U1 Base: shaper calibrate
author: bespoked
description:
Part of the U1 Base Layer. It updates the printer's input shaper calculation so very low frequency noise in a measurement no longer skews the result.

What changes:
• Frequencies below the useful range are damped before the shaper is chosen, so calibration picks a shaper that matches how the printer really moves.

Install this because a plugin you want asks for it. Under the hood it edits Klipper's own program files on the printer. Uninstalling puts the originals back, and it re-applies itself after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Newer Klipper input shaper calculation, so calibration is not skewed by low frequency noise.
